Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing all sections in chapter 77.110 RCW.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing all sections in chapter 77.110 RCW;and repealing RCW 77.110.010, 77.110.020, 77.110.030, 77.110.040,77.110.900, and 77.110.901.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 77.110.010 (Declaration) and 1985 c 1 s 1; RCW 77.110.020 (Petition to congress) and 1985 c 1 s 2; RCW 77.110.030 (Management of natural resourcesState policy)and 1985 c 1 s 3; RCW 77.110.040 (DeclarationDenial of rights based on race,sex, origin, or cultural heritage) and 1985 c 1 s 4; RCW 77.110.900 (Transmittal of act to president and congress1985 c 1) and 1985 c 1 s 5; and RCW 77.110.901 (Severability1985 c 1) and 1985 c 1 s 6.
